skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, characteristics of real estate and real estate market, formation and development stages of the real estate market, supply and demand characteristics, price factors, and government management tools for the real estate market.
Analyze the real estate market with specific situations.
Develop systematic thinking, information gathering skills, analysis of supply, demand, and prices in the real estate market.
Demonstrate professionalism, persistence, cooperation in work through individual and group tasks.
Have critical thinking skills and update situations related to the real estate market.
Develop independent working ability and teamwork when participating in professional activities.
Express and defend personal views based on objective and scientific approaches.
Identify and fulfill social responsibility and professional ethics in making judgments and evaluations about professional issues related to the real estate market.
